sites.notes: Squirrly account is bound to this exact URL via the USER-URL header. site_key_ref + blog_id are REQUIRED once the site's plugin has completed its handshake; without them the server answers 403 signature_required, which reads like a bad token. Both come from wp_options sq_options (sq_site_key, sq_user_blog_id). Omit BOTH for a brand that has not handshaked; never one.
